first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a targeted simplification test the most direct response. Verify the prior signup and onboarding evidence, test primarily with SMB/self-serve accounts, and retain the full flow for complex-workspace accounts because of the documented early-churn risk. This avoids broad promotional pricing, whose retention damage conflicts with sustainable qualified revenue.

final.rationale: Run a guarded onboarding simplification experiment for simple SMB/self-serve accounts, where prior evidence shows higher completion and activation with only a small retention decline. Exclude complex-workspace accounts because shortened onboarding increased 60-day churn by 9% there. Monitor activation, completion, time-to-value, 30-day retention, 60-day churn, and qualified revenue before considering expansion.
